types.name: items
types.description: The items to add to the fulfillment.

types.name: location_id
types.description:
The ID of the stock location
to fulfill the items from.

types.name: shipping_option_id
types.description:
The ID of the shipping option to use for the fulfillment.
Overrides the shipping option selected by the customer.

types.name: no_notification
types.description: Whether to notify the customer about this change.

types.name: delivery_address
types.description:
The recipient address to use for the fulfillment. It's merged over the
order's shipping address, allowing you to override recipient details
(such as the first and last name) sent to the fulfillment provider.

children.name: first_name
children.description: The first name of the address.

children.name: last_name
children.description: The last name of the address.

children.name: phone
children.description: The phone number of the address.

children.name: address_1
children.description: The first address line of the address.

children.name: address_2
children.description: The second address line of the address.

children.name: country_code
children.description: The country code of the address.

children.name: province
children.description: The lower-case [ISO 3166-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO\_3166-2) province/state of the address.

children.name: postal_code
children.description: The postal code of the address.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Holds custom data in key-value pairs.
